'70 Chevy Chevelle SS.descripcion: The Chevrolet Chevelle is an automobile produced by the Chevrolet division of General Motors from 1964 to 1977 over three generations, initially as part of the Malibu lineup. Styled by Bill Mitchell, the 1970 Chevelle saw a significant restyling, now featuring coke bottle styling typical of the era. This casting depicts a 1970 Chevrolet Chevelle SS modified for road racing with wide bodykit, custom cowl hood, front splitter, fender flares, ducktail wing, custom side exhausts and lowered ride height. The rollbar is integrated into the interior piece while the racing seat is part of the baseplate. '55 Chevy Bel Air Gasser.descripcion: This casting depicts a gasser version of the 1955 Chevrolet Bel Air. The 2020 Boulevard release of this casting is based on the 'Tri 5 By Fire', a Bel Air gasser owned by Jon Chase of Hoonigan. Chase happened upon the car sitting underneath a freeway in poor condition. He later restored and built the car into a gasser. The 2021 RLC and 2022 Mainline releases of this casting are based on the "Triassic Five", designer Brendon Vetuskey's own 1955 Chevy Bel Air Gasser; he would sell the car in 2023 to Terry Pharo.

Datsun Bluebird 510.descripcion: The Datsun Bluebird 510 sedan, also known as the "Poor man's BMW", was one of the most popular Datsun cars ever made. Built from 1967-1973, the Datsun Bluebird 510 was also known as the Datsun 1600, Datsun 1500, Datsun 1300 and simply Datsun Bluebird. The Datsun Bluebird 510 was originally designed by the Nissan-Datsun company in Japan. The name "Bluebird 510" was only used in Canada and the United States. The casting was retooled twice; once in 2016 for RLC use where it gained an opening hood, and once in 2019 for the mainline where the original construction was modified for cost cutting, becoming a post-post design instead of a post-tab design, the interior no longer having a roll cage and less base detailing.

This new DOHC (dual overhead camshaft) engine (which was designed by the former Prince engineers) produced 160 hp (118 kW, 180 N·m). This casting is based on the iconic Hakosuka race cars which dominated the Fuji Speedway through the 1970's. Competing in the Grand Champion series, the three cars built won the race 49 times in a row, with 58 overall wins. It was often said that the Skylines only rival was the Skyline itself. Porsche 993 GT2.descripcion: The Porsche 911 GT2 is a high-performance track-focused version of the Porsche 911, initially introduced in 1993. The GT2 was introduced with the 993-generation 911, and as a result is often known as the 993 GT2. Built to comply with homologation requirements for GT2 class racing, the 993 GT2 is powered by a 3.6L M64.60 turbocharged flat-6, mated to a 6-speed manual. Compared to other 911s, the GT2 featured a large rear wing and widened fenders. The car made 424 horsepower when initially released; this would be increased to 444 by production's end in 1998. Because of its extreme nature the GT2 became known as a "widow maker". 57 cars were produced, making the 993 GT2 one of the rarest Porsches of its time.

'84 Mustang SVO.descripcion: The Ford Mustang SVO was a limited-production variant of the third generation Ford Mustang produced from 1984 to 1986. Unlike its predecessor the Mustang Cobra, the SVO was designed differently than most mainstream Mustang models. The SVO was designed by Ford's Special Vehicle Operations (SVO) Department, hence the "SVO" nameplate. Like its predecessor, the Mustang Cobra, the SVO was also a liftback design. Unlike many other performance-oriented Mustangs, the SVO was powered by a 2.3L turbocharged Lima inline-4 also used in the Mustang GTP; during its short run, the SVO was the most expensive and the fastest Mustang available at the time. 9,844 were produced, of which 4,508 were in 1984.

By the time of the introduction of the Mark II Transit in 1978, the Transit Supervan had been retired from promotional duties. Nissan Skyline C210.descripcion: The Nissan Skyline C210 is the succeeding model to the C110 "Kenmeri" Skyline from the early to mid-1970s. With a production run from 1977-1981 model years, this generation of Skyline did not feature a GT-R model, as the oil crisis of 1973 led to the Kenmeri GT-R being pulled from production prematurely. This generation of Skyline however was the first to feature a Turbocharged model, the GT-EX. The Hot Wheels C210 features round headlights, indicating a 1977-78 model, and is pretty much factory spec but features fender flares, a front air dam and lowered stance. The 2018 model's steering wheel is cast in silver, possibly as part of the base. This casting is Right-Hand Drive (RHD), as standard on all Japanese-market vehicles.

Shelby Cobra Daytona Coupe.descripcion: The Shelby Daytona Coupe is an American sport prototype coupe produced by Shelby American from 1964 to 1965. Designed by Carroll Shelby and Peter Brock, the Daytona was related to the Cobra, sharing a similar chassis and drivetrain and it essentially being an advanced evolution of the Cobra. Designed to beat Ferrari at the top echelon of endurance racing, the Daytona Coupe was powered by a 289 ci (4.7L) Ford small block V8. With the Daytona, Shelby won the 1965 International Championship for GT Manufacturers, the first American constructor to do so; Ford would later reassign Shelby to head the highly successful GT40 program. Six chassis were built.

'17 Ford F-150 Raptor.descripcion: The Ford F-150 Raptor is the highest-performance version of the Ford F-150. The second generation of the F-150 Raptor was designed by Gordon Platto and was introduced in 2017 as a 2017 model year model; it was based on the thirteenth-generation F-150. It uses a 3.5L EcoBoost D35 twin-turbocharged V6 mated to a Ford 10-speed 10R80 automatic; it was the first vehicle to use said transmission. As with previous generations the F-150 Raptor is intended for off-road capability and features off-road tires and Fox Racing shocks. Production ended in 2020, being replaced by the next generation of F-150 Raptor.

'69 Ford Mustang Boss 302.descripcion: This casting is a depiction of a 1969 Ford Mustang intended for Trans Am racing. This casting, while very similar in appearance to the '70 Ford Mustang Boss 302, is a different casting and is not to be confused with it; it is likely that this casting was modified from the earlier '70 Ford Mustang casting hence their similar outward appearance. Due to their similar appearance parts from one casting can be switched with another. The casting has undergone two retools over the course of its life. In 2015, the casting lost its metal base and plastic spoiler, the latter being integrated into the body. The casting went through a further retool in 2019 where the front grill and rear panel were made part of the base.

'76 Greenwood Corvette.descripcion: The 1976 Greenwood Corvette was a high-performance endurance silhouette racing car designed by Greenwood Corvettes for use in endurance racing. Despite bearing the Corvette name, the Greenwood Corvette shared close to nothing with that of the Corvettes of the time apart from a passing resemblance. The car's distinctive shape gave it the nickname of "Batmobile". The 1976 Greenwood Corvettes were built on tubeframe chassis and competed in the IMSA Camel GT Series, Trans Am Series and occasionally at Le Mans. The cars were powered by 7.7L aluminum big block V8s producing 725 horsepower, which were powerful enough to give these cars 215 mph (346 km/h) on Le Mans's Mulsanne Straight. Twelve chassis were produced.

McLaren F1 GTR.descripcion: The McLaren F1 GTR is a high performance racing version of the standard McLaren F1 used in GT racing. Designed by Gordon Murray and powered by a 6.1L BMW S70/2 V12, the F1 GTR was a successful race car, winning 38 races of the over 120 races it participated in. The car was manufactured in numerous different configurations. 28 chassis of the 106 F1s produced were GTRs; these were raced as late as 2005. The base of early versions of the casting reads McLaren F 1 GTR. Despite the name, this casting actually depicts a McLaren F1 LM as it features the two side seats not present on the GTR racing models. The casting lost its plastic wing when it entered the mainline for the first time in 2017; the plastic wing reappeared in 2018 when it was used in the Gran Turismo series as well as the Gulf Car

Baja Bug.descripcion: The Baja Bug is a Hot Wheels casting based on the Volkswagen Beetle that was designed for Mattel by Larry Wood. The casting debuted in the 1984 Real Riders Series. Why "Baja"? Well, the Baja California Peninsula in northwest Mexico is home to the Mexican 1000 off-road race. The Baja Bugs were developed in the late 1960s as a homemade alternative to the fiberglass-bodied Meyers Manx beach buggies of the era that excelled in the sandy, hilly terrain. To make a Baja Bug, you take a stock VW Beetle, chopped off the front and back portions of the car at an angle, add fill-in panels, oversized trim and fenders, tune the exposed engine and put on a set of wide balloon or paddle-tread tires. This casting has also gone by the name VW Baja, VW-Käfer Spezial, Baja Beetle, Volkswagen Baja Bug and Volk

Toyota Supra.descripcion: The Toyota Supra is a sports car produced by Toyota since 1978. Its name is derived from the Latin term "supra", translating to "to go beyond". The fourth generation Supra, colloquially known as the A80 or the Mk4, was designed by Isao Tsuzuki and was largely based on the Toyota Soarer. The car is powered by the 2JZ 3.0L inline-6, available in naturally-aspirated and twin-turbocharged iterations. This generation of Supra had Toyota place more emphasis on a more serious high-powered car. Since its discontinuation in 2002, the A80 Supra has gained a cult following among automotive enthusiasts and the modification scene, especially after its appearances in mass media such as Initial D and the Fast & Furious franchise. '16 Bugatti Chiron.descripcion: The Bugatti Chiron is a limited production very high-performance mid-engined sports car produced by Bugatti Automobiles S.A.S. Unveiled at the 2016 Geneva Motor Show, the Chiron acts as the successor to the Bugatti Veyron; its design was previewed by the Vision Gran Turismo shown off in 2015. It is powered by an 8.0L DALA quad-turbocharged W16 mated to a 7-speed dual clutch; the engine produces 1,479 horsepower although later versions have higher horsepower ratings. The car is one of the fastest cars in the world by both acceleration and top speed, with various records broken by the Chiron. Production began in 2016 and ended in 2024; 500 were produced. The car was replaced by the Tourbillon in 2025.

Originally introduced in 2007 as a 2009 model year model, the GT-R received a significant facelift for the 2017 model year, featuring new front and rear fascias, reshaped C-pillars and a strengthened hood. Other aesthetic changes were made to the car's interior.

'49 Ford F1.descripcion: The Ford F-Series is a series of trucks produced by the Ford Motor Company. The first generation, introduced in 1948 and also known as the Bonus-Built series, marked a divergence between truck and car design, using a chassis designed specifically for truck use. Production of the first generation ended in 1952.

'64 Prince Skyline GT.descripcion: The Prince Skyline is the predecessor vehicle to what would become the Nissan Skyline. The second generation of the Skyline, styled by Shinichiro Sakurai and internally designated the S50, was the final generation to be branded as a Prince. Powered by a 1.5L G-1 inline-4, the Prince Skyline quickly became one of the most desirable cars of the time. Production ended in 1968 with 114,238 produced. The initial livery is based on the #39 Skyline GT that competed in the 1964 Japanese Grand Prix; at the time the race was a sports car racing event and would only become a Formula One race in 1976. The car was driven by Yoshikazu Sunako and finished second behind a Porsche 904.

'64 Chevy Nova Wagon.descripcion: The '64 Chevy Nova Wagon is the station wagon version of the first generation Chevrolet Nova. This was one of the many station wagons offered in the 1960s. At that time, station wagons (or 'estate cars') were a popular vehicle choice for families because of their ability to carry large loads and small groups of people without the need for a large van. Station wagons were essentially the minivans of the 1960's and 1970's; family cars with lots of carrying room for luggage and passengers. The Hot Wheels casting portrays a custom Chevy Nova 4-door Wagon with molded luggage in the rear cargo area. This model was named the 64 Chevy Nova Station Wagon until 2017.

In comparison to the Road Runner it was based on, the car featured a smoother body profile, a lengthened body and an extremely large rear wing. '70 Rover P6 Group 2.descripcion: The Rover P6 Series is a series of executive sedans built by The Rover Co. Ltd., Leyland Motors and British Leyland from 1963 to 1977. Designed by Spen King, Gordon Bashford and David Bache as a replacement to the Rover P4 and P5, the P6 was a complete "clean sheet" design intended to appeal to a larger number of buyers. A highly successful automobile, 322,302 were produced; the designers of the P6 would later move on to create the highly successful Range Rover. The P6 would be replaced by the SD1. Two P6s were rebuilt by British Leyland's Competition Department in 1968 as race cars intended to comply with FIA's Group 2 regulations. '71 AMC Javelin.descripcion: The AMC Javelin AMX is a performance-oriented version of the AMC Javelin, introduced in 1971; it was spun off from the previous AMX line of two-door coupes to become a trim level of the Javelin. It was advertised as "the closest thing you can buy to a Trans Am champion"; true to its name, the Javelin also went Trans Am racing, most notably by Penske Racing and driven by road course specialists Mark Donohue and George Follmer; other notable drivers included Vic Elford, Peter Revson and Roy Woods. The Javelin would end up becoming a three-time champion in the series, winning the 1971, 1972 and 1976 Trans Am championships. The base of the casting reads 71 AMC Javelin AMX.

'73 BMW 3.0 CSL Race Car.descripcion: The '73 BMW 3.0 CSL is a racing variation of the BMW 3.0 Saloon (the E9, as it may also be called). The BMW 3.0 CSL was a Euro-spec 3.0 CS with aluminum bodywork to shed some weight for better on-track performance, with the CSL variant about 440 pounds (200 kg) less than the standard 3.0 CS. The 'L' standing for "leicht", German for 'Lightweight'. The Hot Wheels is based off the CSL that won in the European Touring Car Championship (ETCC) and in the from 1975 through until 1979 ETT+CC. A mere 1,265 models of the 3.0 CSL rolled off the assembly line, with this rarity, one can cost upwards of $350,000 (~€305,000) to purchase one.

'73 Holden Monaro GTS.descripcion: The Holden Monaro was an Australian rear-wheel drive coupe produced by General Motors's Holden division from 1968 to 1975 and subsequently from 2001 to 2006. The second generation Monaro, the HQ and HJ, featured a new body style compared to the previous generation Monaro. No more six-cylinder engines were available with this generation's early years, with only V8s being available. A 1972 Monaro notably appeared in the film Mad Max. This casting depicts a lightly modified Holden Monaro with lower ride height and a race-style interior, sporting a single front bucket seat and rollcage but retaining both rear seats.

'73 Volvo 142 GL.descripcion: The Volvo 140 Series is a series of mid-sized automobiles produced by Volvo from 1966 to 1974, split into the 142, 144 and 145 models, each differing by their body style and number of doors (142 was a two-door coupe, 144 was a four-door sedan and 145 was a five-door wagon) and each with their own varying trim levels. Designed by Jan Wilsgaard, the 140 was the first Volvo to feature a boxier body style; compared to the Amazons which it replaced, there was little carryover on both the interior and exterior. Production ended in 1974, with the car replaced by the 200 Series. 1,251,371 were produced, becoming Volvo's first car to achieve a million sales. This casting replicates a lightly-modified Volvo 142 GL with lowered stance and a racing-style interior among other modifications.

'77 Toyota Celica.descripcion: The Toyota Celica is a sports car produced by Toyota from 1970 to 2006. The first generation Celica, internally designated the A20, was designed by Masao Fujita under Tatsuo Hasegawa and introduced at the 1970 Tokyo Motor Show; it was intended to emphasize driving enjoyment. Initially only available as a pillarless hardtop coupe adopting coke bottle styling, the car was aimed at the North American market and was in effect Toyota's response to the Ford Mustang. A liftback was introduced in 1973, while the car was facelifted in 1972, 1974 and 1976; production ended in July 1977 to be replaced by the next generation of Celica. This casting depicts a modified 1977 Celica liftback.

'81 Toyota Starlet KP61.descripcion: The Toyota Starlet was a series of subcompact automobiles sold by Toyota from 1973 through 1999, replacing the Toyota Publica but retaining the "P" chassis codes used by its predecessor; the first generation Starlets were actually sold as the Publica Starlet. The second generation Starlet was the first of the Starlets to be exported and was sold from 1978 to 1984. This generation has been very popular among the drag racing community for many years. This casting is based on a highly-modified KP61 Toyota Starlet. In development this casting was titled the 83 Toyota Starlet.

'82 Toyota Supra.descripcion: Debuted for the first time to the North American public in 1977 as "The Car of the '80s" in US ads, the Toyota Celica Supra was a spinoff of the Celica. Produced from 1982 to 1986, the second generation of the Supra appeared similar to the Celica it was spun off from but featured a longer wheelbase and a different front fascia. This casting is based on the '82 Supra casting designed by Larry Wood in 1983, but is heavily updated, featuring a single exposed pop-up headlamp "wink", lowered stance, wider bolt-on fenders, hood vents, louvered rear and side windows, a small ducktail spoiler and front and rear diffusers and lips. Compared to the older casting the new casting's body lines are slightly wider even without the widebody kit.

'87 Ford Sierra Cosworth.descripcion: The Ford Sierra was a large family car designed by Uwe Bahnsen, Bob Lutz and Patrick le Quément. The car was intended to replace the Ford Cortina and Taunus lines. The RS Cosworth was a high-performance version of the Ford Sierra, fitted with a 2.0L turbocharged Cosworth inline-4. This casting depicts an Sierra RS500 Cosworth, the most powerful version with a further refined engine, made in a limited series of 500 examples and campaigned in many Group A racing and rally series from 1987 on. It can be distinguished from the regular RS Cosworth by the indent below the grille which opens an extra air intake not found on the regular RS and the lower lip spoiler below the large 'whale-tail' wing which the regular RS lacks.

'88 Chevy Silverado 3500.descripcion: The Chevrolet C and K series are a series of two- and four-wheel drive trucks sold by the Chevrolet division of General Motors from 1960 to 2002. The fourth and final generation of the trucks, the GMT400, styled by Donald Wood, was introduced in April 1987 to replace the aging "Rounded Line" series of trucks; the trucks are colloquially known as the "OBS" Chevys. Design operations were handled by General Motors Truck and Bus Group, with computer data taking a greater role in the design of the vehicle. This generation was the final generation of the C and K series, which was discontinued in 2002 and replaced with the Chevrolet Silverado, now becoming its own separate model. This casting features a hitch to attach a trailer. The base of the casting reads 88 Chevrolet Silverado 3500.

'89 Toyota Supra.descripcion: The Toyota Supra is a series of sports cars produced by Toyota. The third generation of the Supra, introduced in 1986, was a completely new model no longer based on the Celica and now related to the Soarer. The car was available with various inline-6s, from the 2.0L 1G-EU to the 3.0L turbocharged 7M-GTE; the 7M series of engines was deemed the "flagship" engine of Toyota's arsenal. Changes made to the Supra for the 1989 model year were mostly mechanical and performance-related such as a new location for the wastegate actuator. Production of this generation of Supra ended in 1993 to be replaced by the next generation of Supra.

'89 Porsche 944 Turbo.descripcion: The Porsche 944 is a sports car designed by Harm Laagay and produced at Porsche's plant in Neckarsulm in Stuttgart from 1982 to 1991. '92 Dodge Viper RT/10.descripcion: The Dodge Viper is a sports car manufactured by the Dodge division of Stellantis (formerly Fiat Chrysler Automobiles) from 1991 to 2017. The first generation Dodge Viper, styled by Tom Gale and codenamed the SR I, was created as what was essentially a modern version of the Shelby Cobra. The car was powered by an 8.0L odd-firing Viper EWA V10 making 400 horsepower, with variations of this power plant powering the Viper for its entire lifespan. After a series of updates the Viper was facelifted in 1995 as the SR II. The base of the casting reads Dodge Viper RT/10. In comparison to the original Dodge Viper RT/10 casting introduced in 1992, it features better proportions, a lower stance and better detailing including side mirrors. It features hidden engine detail when taken apart.

Designed by Tom Matano, Wu-huang Chin and Yoichi Sato, the RX-7 Spirit R featured numerous performance upgrades over the standard RX-7, such as Bilstein dampers, drilled and vented brake discs, unique BBS alloy wheels, adjustable rear wing blade and an uprated 276 hp 1.3L 13B-REW two-rotor engine. The RX-7 Spirit R was available in three distinct configurations, named Type A, B and C, with each having a different combination of seating layout and transmission. 1,504 were produced. The base of the casting reads Mazda RX-7 Spirit R.

2001 BMW M5.descripcion: The BMW M5 is the high-performance version of the BMW 5 Series, produced since 1984. The E39 5 Series, designed by Joji Nagashima, served as the platform for the third generation of the M5, powered by a 4.9L S62 V8. The E39 was the first M5 to use a V8 engine and the first to use aluminum front suspension components and multi-link rear suspension. A total of 20,482 cars were produced from 1999 to 2003. The base of the casting reads 2001 BMW M5 E39.

2002 Pontiac Firebird.descripcion: The Pontiac Firebird is a pony car produced by the Pontiac division of General Motors. The final generation, introduced in 1993, was styled by John Folden and featured significantly amplified aerodynamic styling compared to the previous generation reflecting that of the Banshee. Trim levels included Firebird, Formula and Trans Am. Production ended in 2002. 23,330 were produced. This casting depicts a 2002 Pontiac Firebird Trans Am.

2005 Mitsubishi Lancer Evolution IX Wago.descripcion: The Mitsubishi Lancer Evolution IX is the ninth generation of the Mitsubishi Lancer Evolution, the sports sedan and rally-tuned version of the Mitsubishi Lancer. The Evo IX, as it is colloquially known, was designed by Shuzō Akamine and Hiroshi Fujii and produced from 2005 to 2007. It was also available in wagon form and was available in three trim levels, GT, GT-A and MR; production ended in 2007 with the car replaced with the Evolution X, with the wagon body style dropped for the next generation. 2,924 were produced.

2003 Honda NSX Type-R.descripcion: The Honda NSX was a mid-engined two-seat sports car manufactured by Honda from 1990 to 2005. Styled by Ken Okuyama, Masahito Nakano, Shigeru Uehara and James Stevens, the NSX was Honda's flagship offering, intended to compete with such cars like the Ferrari 348. It was powered by a 3.0L C30B V6; this was changed to a 3.2L C32B V6 later in the car's life. The car was facelifted in 2002 to keep it modern-looking, with fixed xenon high-intensity discharge beams as opposed to pop-up headlights. The NSX-R was a performance-oriented version of the NSX, intended for customers who wanted a "no-compromise" experience on the track with their cars. The NSX was discontinued in 2005; the name would be revived in 2017 after some years of development.

2004 Volkswagen Golf R32.descripcion: The Volkswagen Golf R32 is a high-performance version of the Volkswagen Golf produced from 2002 to 2004. Designed by Peter Schreyer and Hartmut Warkuß, the R32 was powered by a 3.2L BFH VR6 producing 238 hp mated to a 6-speed manual or dual clutch, the world's first car to be so equipped with a dual clutch transmission. Many mechanical components were shared with the Audi TT. Following discontinuation of the Mk4 Golf on which the R32 was based, a second generation R32 was produced with the introduction of the Mk5 generation. 12,000 were produced. This casting is based on a 2004 Golf R32 owned by Hot Wheels packaging designer Matt Gabe. The base of the casting reads 04 Volkswagen Golf R32.

2008 Porsche Cayenne.descripcion: The Porsche Cayenne (pronounced "kay-enn") is a luxury crossover SUV manufactured by Porsche since 2002. The first generation, internally designated the 9PA and styled by Steve Murkett, was Porsche's first entry into the SUV market; the Cayenne was Porsche's first off-road capable vehicle since the Junior and Super Junior tractors in the 1950s, the first Porsche with four doors and the first Porsche built with a V8 engine since the 928. The car's name was coined by German advertising agent Manfred Gotta and was launched to an initially mixed reception which warmed over time due to its good performance, handling and powerful engines; the first generation was discontinued in 2010. The Cayenne has since become one of Porsche's sales leaders. This casting features a hitch to attach a trailer.

The Sierra was restyled in 2022 by Thomas Bergeron, while two additional trim levels were introduced, namely the AT4X and Denali Ultimate. This generation is expected to be replaced in 2026 with a new generation of Sierra. This casting features a hitch to attach a trailer.

2024 Toyota Land Cruiser.descripcion: The Toyota Land Cruiser Prado is a full-sized four-wheel drive SUV produced by Toyota since 1984. It is related to the standard Land Cruiser but is smaller than it. The vehicle is marketed as the Land Cruiser in North America and some European countries, the Land Cruiser 250 in Japan and the Land Cruiser Prado in other markets; it is also badged as the Lexus GX 550 in some markets. 2025 BMW M5.descripcion: The BMW M5 is the high-performance version of the BMW 5 Series, produced since 1984. The seventh generation of the M5, styled by José Casas and internally designated the G90, was based on the G60 generation of the 5 Series and entered production in 2024 for the 2025 model year. Introduced in June 2024, the G90 M5 is BMW's first plug-in hybrid M5 model; it is powered by a 4.4L S68 twin-turbocharged V8 paired with an electric motor system to produce a combined 717 horsepower. A station wagon version, the M5 Touring, was also made available in this generation; it was the first M5 to be made available in this configuration since 2010.

Back to the Future Time Machine.descripcion: The DeLorean Time Machine is the focal vehicle in the Back to the Future movie series; the vehicle was made through the retrofitting of a DeLorean DMC-12 with a flux capacitor. Three were built by Universal Studios for the film, named the A, B and C cars; those acted as the "Hero" car, the Stunt car and the Interior Close-Up car respectively. Additional replicas were made for future films. The casting was retooled for 2022, with the rear taillamp section being made part of the interior, some portions of the rear being made part of the base, some parts of the vents and the reactor being made part of the body and the reactor getting additional detail. Any form of base texturing was also removed.

BMW M3 E46.descripcion: The BMW M3 is a high-performance version of the BMW 3 Series produced since 1986. The third generation of the M3, based on the E46 generation of the 3 Series, was designed by Ulf Weidhase and was available in coupe and convertible body styles; it was unveiled in full-production form at the 2000 Geneva Motor Show and was produced from September 2000 to August 2006. It is powered by a 3.2L S54B32 inline-6 mated to a 6-speed manual or automated manual transmission. 85,766 were produced, split between 56,133 coupes and 29,633 convertibles. The M3 appears for a very brief time in Furious 7 as a background car. Corvette C8.R.descripcion: The Chevrolet Corvette C8.R is a grand touring racing car built by Pratt & Miller for Corvette Racing for use in endurance racing. Styled by Vlad Kapitonov, the car is the successor to the Chevrolet Corvette C7.R, also built by the same company. First seeing competition in 2020, the C8.R competed in both the IMSA SportsCar Championship and the World Endurance Championship, as a GTE/GTLM homologated vehicle. In 2022 and 2023 the car also received a GTD kit to allow it to compete in the GTD Pro class among GT3 cars. Powered by a flat-plane 5.5L LT6 V8, the car has seen significant success in endurance racing competitions, particularly in the IMSA SportsCar Championship where Corvette Racing won the Teams', Constructors' and Drivers' championships in 2020 and 2021. The car was powered by a 2.8L PRV ZMJ-159 V6 mated to either a 5-speed manual or a 3-speed automatic. De Tomaso Pantera Gruppo 4.descripcion: The De Tomaso Pantera was a mid-engined sports car produced by De Tomaso Automobili from 1971 to 1992. Designed by Tom Tjaarda of Ghia, the Pantera was the successor of the Mangusta and debuted at Modena in 1970. As was tradition with many De Tomaso cars, the Pantera used an American V8, which in this case was a 5.8L Ford Cleveland V8. 7,260 were produced. This casting is a depiction of a Pantera GTS prepared for Group 4 racing. The "351" number on the side is a reference to the capacity of the engine in cubic inches (351 ci/5.8L). The initial livery of this casting is based on the Panteras run by the De Tomaso works team in Group 4 competition.

The Testarossa was powered by a 4.9L F113 flat-12 mated to a 5-speed manual; this engine produced 385 horsepower. The Testarossa's styling is noted for its side strakes, nicknamed by the press as "cheese graters" but would later become a statement of style of the 1980s. Fiat 131 Abarth.descripcion: The Fiat 131 is a small family sedan manufactured by Fiat from 1974 to 1984. Succeeding the 124, the 131 used a steel body design with a front-engined rear-wheel drive layout. The 131 Abarth Rally was a limited-production version built for homologation purposes, built in collaboration with Fiat, Bertone and Abarth. A highly-successful rally car, especially in Group 4, the 131 won the World Rally Championship for manufacturers in 1977, 1978 and 1980. 400 were produced.

This was Jaguar's first small sedan since the 1½ and 2½ Litre cars were discontinued in 1949, with the Mark 1 ending up becoming a big success for Jaguar, easily outselling their larger sedans. The car was replaced in 1959 by the Mark 2. 37,397 were produced. This casting features hidden engine detail when taken apart. The initial livery is a depiction of the Jaguar Mark 1 driven by British classic car racer Grant Williams, featuring the british "BUY 1" license plates used on an identical racing Jaguar in the late 1950s. Kool Kombi.descripcion: Kool Kombi portrays a first-generation split window Volkswagen Type 2 minibus. The Hot Wheels casting shows a customized "Shorty" delivery variant with an open tailgate and surfboards sticking out the back. There is also a huge stinger exhaust pipe and two small stabilizer wheelie bars on the rear of the vehicle; these are highly recommended for a shorty bus for side and rear stabilization in the event of tipping or flipping. Usually when a shorty was made through shortening modifications a limousine bus was also made in the process. This casting was originally released as the Volkswagen Kool Kombi; this name was only used for the first five mainline releases (some special editions did not have the "Volkswagen" prefix) before the "Volkswagen" portion was dropped for all subsequent releases

Lamborghini Aventador LP 700-4.descripcion: The Lamborghini Aventador LP 700-4 is a mid-engined sports car produced by the Italian manufacturer Lamborghini. The Aventador has since spawned numerous variants and one-offs based on the same basic platform. The LP 700-4 model was discontinued in 2016, being replaced with the Aventador S in 2017.

Lamborghini Essenza SCV12.descripcion: The Lamborghini Essenza SCV12 is a track-only high-performance sports car produced by Lamborghini under their Squadra Corse motorsports division. Designed by Mitja Borkert and developed according to FIA prototype safety rules, the car uses the same 6.5L L539 V12 as the Aventador SVJ but features numerous modifications to allow the car to become the most powerful V12-powered car in Lamborghini's lineup. Production totaled 40 cars, with each costing $2.5 million. Deliveries began in December 2020. The car is planned to have its own one-make racing series and when not in use is stored in a hangar near the factory where it is built in Sant'Agata Bolognese; unlike equivalent programs like the Ferrari XX Program, owners can take delivery of their cars and keep them on their own. Lamborghini Countach LP 5000 QV.descripcion: The Lamborghini Countach is a rear-mid engined sports car produced by Lamborghini from 1974 to 1990. Designed by Marcello Gandini and Paolo Stanzani, the car popularized the "wedge" shape for many Italian sports cars, particularly future Lamborghinis. The LP 5000 QV is one of the later enhancements of the Countach, with the Lamborghini V12 stroked to 5.2L and given four valves per cylinder, hence the name QV; quattrovalvole. 610 cars were produced in this specification. The base of the casting reads Lamborghini Countach LP5000; this was later changed to Lamborghini Countach LP5000 QV in 2023. This casting is a modification of Ryu Asada's Lamborghini Countach Pace Car casting sans lightbar.

Lancia Delta S4.descripcion: The Lancia Delta S4 is a rally car manufactured by Abarth for Lancia intended for competition in the FIA World Rally Championship. Designed by Renato Sconfienza, Bruno Giardino and Sergio Limone under Pier Paolo Messori, the Delta S4 was homologated for Group B and acted as the successor to the 037. It was powered by a 1.8L Tipo 233 ATR 18S twincharged inline-4 mated to a 5-speed Hewland transmission; the engine produced 550 horsepower. First entered into competition in 1985, the Delta S4 won 5 of the 12 races it entered in the WRC and was withdrawn from competition in 1986 following the banning of Group B as a class due to repeated deaths. 28 chassis were produced.

Lancia Stratos Zero.descripcion: The Lancia Stratos Zero is a wedge-shaped concept grand touring sports car produced by Lancia. Designed by Marcello Gandini of Bertone, the Stratos Zero premiered at the 1970 Turin Auto Show; it was created from a crashed Fulvia HF1600 rally car, reusing its chassis and 1.6L V4 engine. The car named as such due to the space-age stratosphere which was in vogue at the time. Notable for its wedge shape and low height of 84 centimeters (33.1 in), it is said that Gandini drove the car underneath the Lancia's factory barriers to great applause from Lancia's factory workers. Long having been exhibited at the Musée Bertone in Turin, the car is currently privately owned, having been sold at an auction in 2011.

The Land Rover 90 Defender was the 2-door short-wheelbase version of the Defender with the aforementioned 110 model being the long-wheelbase version.

Lexus RC F GT3.descripcion: The Lexus RC F GT3 is a grand touring race car built by Toyota Gazoo Racing for Lexus for use in endurance racing. Homologated for the GT3 category and powered by a 540 horsepower 5.4L 2UR-GSE V8, the RC F GT3 was unveiled at the 2015 Detroit Auto Show. MBK Van.descripcion: The MBK Van is an unlicensed Hot Wheels van casting that loosely resembles that of Japanese-style vans. The van features two rows of bucket seats arranged three abreast, with a sculpted stuffed elephant situated in one of the passenger seats; the casting itself is a homage to Hot Wheels' Thailand plant team, with the elephant situated inside to pay homage to Thailand's national animal. The casting was intended to represent one of a number of lowered vans which would transport Mattel employees around; "MBK" is a reference to Mattel's Thailand plant, Mattel Bangkok.

MG Metro 6R4.descripcion: The MG Metro 6R4 (6-Cylinder, Rally, 4-Wheel Drive) is a racing version of the Austin Metro, prepared for Group B racing. Powered by a Rover V64V 3.0L V6, the Metro 6R4 effectively only shared a superficial resemblance with its the car it took its name from as the racing version was a mid-engined all-wheel drive vehicle. The car was moderately successful in competition but due to the banning of Group B on the grounds of safety the car had a short-lived career in its intended series; it then moved to other racing series. About 205 road-going versions were built for homologation purposes. The initial livery is a replica of Didier Auriol and Bernard Ocelli's car with a different number. In development this casting was named the '86 MG Metro 6R4.

Maserati MC12 (2026).descripcion: The Maserati MC12 is a limited-production high-performance sports car manufactured by Maserati as a homologation special to allow Maserati to field a similar car in various GT championships, signaling their return to racing after 37 years. Designed by Frank Stephenson, the MC12 is based on Ferrari's Enzo Ferrari model but is larger, longer and wider, with the only commonality between both cars externally being the windshield. The MC12 is powered by a 6.0L M144A V12, itself a detuned version of Ferrari's F140B V12; this engine makes 621 horsepower and is mated to a 6-speed Cambiocorsa automated manual. The car has received mixed reviews from journalists. 50 were produced in two batches of 25 models, the later batch being slightly shorter in nose length due to FIA regulations.

The car was stripped of most luxuries and featured a number of performance and aesthetic changes, such as a more aggressive front and rear bumper and an enhanced engine with IHI turbocharger. Introduced in 1992, only about 2,200 were produced. The idea for this model in the Boulevard line was put forth by now-retired Premium designer Mark Jones, with Premium lead designer Ronald Wong designing the model for the line. Maserati MC20.descripcion: The Maserati MC20, named the Maserati MCPura since 2025, is a high-performance two-seat mid-engined sports car manufactured by Maserati. Styled by Klaus Busse of Centro Stile Maserati and unveiled in September 2020, the MC20 acts as the brand's halo car. It is powered by a 3.0L Nettuno twin-turbocharged V6 mated to an 8-speed Tremec dual clutch; the car produces 621 horsepower. An open-topped version, the MC20 Cielo, was introduced in 2022, as well as a number of special variants of the MC20 recalling past performance cars.

Mazda RX-3 Wagon.descripcion: The Mazda RX-3 is a rotary-engined automobile sold by Mazda from 1971 to 1978, it essentially being a rotary-engined version of the Grand Familia, which was largely identical in appearance. The RX-3 was available in sedan, coupe and wagon styles, with the wagon being known as the RX-3 Sports Wagon. The RX-3 Sports Wagon was the world's first rotary-engined wagon and was sold from 1972 to 1976; production of all RX-3s ended in 1978 to make way for the RX-7. The RX-3 was the most successful and popular of all of Mazda's pre-RX-7 rotary models.

McLaren 720S.descripcion: The McLaren 720S is a British sports car designed and manufactured by McLaren Automotive. It is the second brand new car in the McLaren Super Series, replacing the McLaren 650S as of May 2017. The 720S was launched at the Geneva Motor Show on 7 March 2017 and is powered by a 4.0L M840T V8 mated to a 7-speed Graziano dual clutch; the car makes 710 horsepower. It is the first car introduced in McLaren's Track22 plan, McLaren's new business plan involving the launch of 18 new models (or derivatives) by 2022. Production of the 720S ceased in December 2022; the car's replacement is the visually similar 750S.

McLaren P1 GTR.descripcion: The McLaren P1 GTR is a track-only version of the McLaren P1 produced from 2015 to 2016. Designed by Frank Stephenson, the P1 GTR was first unveiled at the 2014 Pebble Beach Concours d'Elegance before the production P1 GTR was unveiled at the 2015 Geneva Motor Show. Similar to the standard P1 the P1 GTR is powered by a 3.8L McLaren M838TQ twin-turbocharged V8 combined with a hybrid system although it now produces 986 horsepower in comparison to the P1. Initially available only to P1 owners, later cars were offered to those who had no interest in purchasing the standard P1 but still wanted the P1 GTR. Priced at about $3 million when new, 58 cars were produced.

The FC was discontinued in 1992 after having gone through two series iterations, and was replaced by the third generation series 6 FD. This casting depicts an FC RX-7 with a Pandem bodykit. McLaren Senna.descripcion: The McLaren Senna is a limited-production track-focused mid-engined high-performance sports car manufactured by McLaren Automotive from 2018 to 2019. McLaren F1.descripcion: The McLaren F1 was a sports car manufactured by McLaren Cars from 1992 to 1998; it was their first production automobile. Designed by ex-Formula One engineer Gordon Murray and Peter Stevens, the F1 was the world's fastest car at the time; it however remains the world's fastest naturally-aspirated automobile. It features a unique three-seat arrangement with the driver sitting in the middle and is powered by a BMW S70/2 6.1L V12. Amongst numerous enthusiasts and publications, the F1 has been christened as "the greatest car of all time"; prices of the F1 at auctions now are usually around the $10 million mark or higher. Only 106 were produced, including 64 road cars, 2 F1 GTs, 5 F1 LMs, 28 F1 GTRs and 7 prototypes (5 road cars, 1 LM, 1 GT).

McLaren Speedtail.descripcion: The McLaren Speedtail is a limited production high-performance sports car manufactured by McLaren Automotive in 2020. Designed by Rob Melville and Alex Alexiev, the Speedtail is the fourth car in McLaren's Ultimate Series of flagship high-performance sports cars; it is powered by a 4.0L M840T twin turbocharged V8 mated to a 7-speed Graziano dual clutch and a hybrid system to produce 1,036 hp, with the car having a claimed top speed of 250 mph (402 km/h). The Speedtail acts as a spiritual successor to the McLaren F1, featuring a three-seat layout and a limited production run of 106 cars, mirroring that of the F1. Each car was priced at $2.1 million.

These cars were nicknamed the "Red Pig" (German: Rote Sau). The cars had short-lived but fairly successful racing careers due to unsuitable tires and rule changes prohibiting the cars from racing. The car won on its debut at the 1955 Mille Miglia, although its racing career was cut short following the 1955 Le Mans disaster and Mercedes-Benz's ensuing withdrawal from all forms of racing. Porsche 718 Cayman GT4.descripcion: The Porsche 718 Cayman is the third generation of the Cayman, introduced in 2016. Designed by Peter Varga, the 718 Cayman is the first generation to use turbocharged engines, with the "718" name chosen to pay tribute to Porsche's racing heritage. The GT4, designed by Fabian Schmölz and introduced in 2019, is a performance-oriented version of the Cayman, using a 4.0L MDG.GA flat-6, a 6-speed manual transmission (a 7-speed dual clutch is available as an option) and a more aggressive stance and bodywork. A more extreme version, the GT4 RS, was introduced in 2021. The base incorrectly shows that the car has a front-engine, rear-wheel-drive layout.

Porsche 904 Carrera GTS.descripcion: The Porsche 904 was a racing sports car manufactured by Porsche from 1964 to 1965. Designed by Ferdinand Alexander Porsche, the 904 was Porsche's first sports car since withdrawing from Formula One in 1962. The Carrera GTS, powered by a 2.0L 587/3 flat-4, was introduced in 1963 to compete in the FIA-GT category at various international racing events. 106 chassis were produced for street legal compliance. The initial livery of this casting is based on chassis 904-005, driven by Antonio Pucci and Colin Davis to victory for Porsche System Engineering in the 1964 Targa Florio.

Porsche 911 Carrera RS 2.7.descripcion: The Porsche 911 Carrera RS was a homologation special of the original Porsche 911. Designed to allow Porsche to compete in FIA Group 4 competition, the Carrera RS featured a larger 2.7L 911/83 flat-6 making 210 horsepower as well as a ducktail spoiler, larger brakes, stiffer suspension and larger rear wheels. A number of additional versions of the Carrera RS were produced, usually with weight-saving modifications; a later version of the Carrera RS featured a bigger engine. 1,580 were produced, comfortably exceeding the 500 cars required for homologation purposes. In modern times, the Carrera RS is highly valued by collectors and is said to be one of the best 911s ever produced.

Porsche 911 GT3.descripcion: The Porsche 911 GT3 is a high-performance homologation model of the Porsche 911, sitting above the 911 Turbo but below the GT2, initially introduced in 1999 with the 996 generation. The fourth generation of the GT3, based on the 992 generation of the Porsche 911, was unveiled in February 2021. The car uses the same 4.0L naturally aspriated MA1.76 flat-6 as its predecessor, the 991 version of the GT3, but uprated to produce 510 BHP. Transmission options include a 7-speed dual clutch or a 6-speed manual. A Touring version featuring a retractable wing is also available.

The 930, produced from 1975 to 1989, featured a Typ 930/60 turbocharged flat-6, initially in a 3.0L configuration; in 1978 the engine's displacement increased to 3.3L and remained that way until the end of production. At the time of its introduction, the 911 Turbo was the fastest production car available in Germany. "Slantnose" versions were also available, and by the end of production in 1989, 21,589 were produced. Porsche 911 GT3 R (992).descripcion: The Porsche 911 GT3 R is a grand touring racing sports car manufactured by Porsche for use in Group GT3 competition. Originally introduced in 1999, the GT3 R is currently in its fourth generation, based on the Porsche 992 platform. It is powered by a 4.2L M97/80 flat-6, now making 565 horsepower. The car competes in racing series such as the World Endurance Championship, IMSA SportsCar Championship and various branches of the GT World Challenge; it made its racing debut at the 2023 24 Hours of Daytona. The initial livery of the casting is based on Rexy, the affectionate nickname for the 911 GT3 R raced by AO Racing in the IMSA SportsCar Championship with a T. rex-inspired livery; the chase livery is based on Roxy, a pink "female" version of Rexy.

Porsche 917 LH.descripcion: The Porsche 917 LH was the second new model version made in cooperation with the 2017 racing game Project CARS 2, developed by Slightly Mad Studios and published by Bandai Namco Entertainment. It is based on the real-life Porsche 917 LH, 'Langheck' (Long Tail). Only five 917 LH were made and competed in the endurance racing in the 1970 and 1971 seasons. The first release of the Hot Wheels 917 LH is a replica of the car #18 driven by Pedro Rodriguez and Jackie Oliver, chassis 917-043, at the 1971 24 Hours of Le Mans; despite having the fastest qualifying time and setting a new lap record they did not complete the race. The car still exists and has been restored to its livery from the previous year (1970) and is on display at the Simeone Foundation Auto Museum.

Porsche 917K.descripcion: The Porsche 917K is a sports prototype racing car manufactured by Porsche for use in endurance racing. Designed by Helmuth Bott, the 917K was a short-tailed version of the 917 family, competing from 1970 to 1971 with some revisions in the design. The 1970 917K was powered by a 4.5L Typ 912 flat-12 producing 580 horsepower, mated to a 5-speed manual. A highly successful race car, the 917 won numerous major endurance races and was one of the first in a line of highly successful Porsche sports prototype race cars which would continue to dominate endurance racing in the following decades. The initial livery of this casting replicates chassis 917-004/017 as driven by Brian Redman and Jo Siffert in the 1970 24 Hours of Le Mans. The base of the casting reads Porsche 917 K.

Porsche 917KH.descripcion: The Porsche 917KH debuted in the collector-aimed 100% line in the Porsche 50th Anniversary 4-Car Set. It featured an opening rear hatch which displayed a detailed engine. Porsche 934.5.descripcion: The Porsche 934/5 is a racing sports car part of the 934 family of race cars. Rare and somewhat unusual, the 934/5 combined traits from both the 934 and 935 models; the car featured the chassis and Typ 930 3.0L turbocharged flat-6 from the 934 and the wheels, tires and wings of the 935. The car was built to compete in Group 4 category racing such as IMSA, but was banned before the car could even compete; as such Porsche entered the car into the SCCA Trans Am Series in 1977, where it dominated and winning the title, though a protest from a competing driver led to the cars losing it. Ten chassis were produced. This casting is modified from Ryu Asada's Porsche 934 Turbo RSR tool, with Jun Imai adding the rear wing, wide fenders and a new front chin.

Porsche Carrera GT.descripcion: The Porsche Carrera GT is a high-performance limited production sports car produced by Dr. Ing. h.c. F. Porsche AG. Styled by Harm Lagaay, the Carrera GT was initially unveiled as a concept car at the 2000 Paris Motor Show, using a 5.5L V10 originally built for Porsche's Formula One exploits. The concept was styled by Jason Hill and was so well-received that Porsche made the decision to produce the car. The production version of the car uses a 5.7L M80/01 V10 mated to a 6-speed manual; this is the only road-going Porsche model to use a V10 engine. Production began in 2004 and ended in 2006, with 1,270 cars produced. Today, the car is one of the most highly-collectible Porsche models.

Porsche 959 (1986).descripcion: The Porsche 959 was a sports car designed by Helmuth Bott and produced by Porsche from 1987 to 1993. With its 2.8L twin-turbocharged flat-6 engine producing 444 horsepower, the 959 was the fastest production street-legal car in the world when first introduced, as well as one of the first high-performance sports cars with an all-wheel drive drivetrain. The cars competed in the Paris-Dakar Rally. The initial release of this casting is intended to resemble the No. 186 Rothmans 959 that participated in the 1986 Paris-Dakar Rally, sans Rothmans logos likely due to tobacco advertisement laws.

Porsche 935 (2021).descripcion: The Porsche 935 is a Group 5 "silhouette" race car developed by Porsche AG and produced from 1977 to 1981. Designed by Norbert Singer, the 935 was a highly competitive race car from the get-go. This initial iteration of the 935, the 935/76, was powered by a 531 BHP 3.0L twin-turbocharged flat-6; later versions of the 935 increase the displacement of the engine. The 935/76s were only owned by Porsche's factory teams while later versions such as the 935/77 and 935/78 were run by privateers in addition to Porsche themselves. About 80 935s of all variants were produced; some 40 by Porsche and another 40 or so by other privateers, particularly Kremer.

Subaru Crosstrek.descripcion: The Subaru Crosstrek is a compact crossover manufactured by Subaru since 2012 based on the Impreza; the first two generations were marketed worldwide as the Subaru XV. The second generation, internally designated the GT, was unveiled at the 2017 Geneva Motor Show. Compared to the previous generation, matte black cladding was added to each side of the vehicle to give it a "rugged flavor". The Crosstrek was facelifted in 2020, giving it more plastic cladding, particularly in the front. This generation was discontinued in 2022; the next generation, the GU, introduced in 2022, drops the XV name, with the vehicle marketed as the Crosstrek worldwide. Subaru Forester STi.descripcion: The Subaru Forester is a compact crossover SUV manufactured by Subaru Corporation since 1997. The second generation of the Forester, introduced at the 2002 Chicago Auto Show, was based on the Impreza platform and a number of weight-saving refinements such as an aluminum hood and a hydro-formed subframe. The Forester STi was a performance-oriented model introduced in 2004 for the Japanese market; it featured revised front and rear fascias, a 2.5L EJ255 turbocharged flat-4, a significantly stronger 6-speed manual transmission, larger intercooler, low-back pressure exhaust system and an added rear spoiler. The Forester STi was not sold outside of Japan. 3,645 were produced. The base of the casting reads 2004 Subaru Forester STi.

Tesla Roadster.descripcion: The Tesla Roadster is a four-seat sports car under development by Tesla, Inc. It is designed by Franz von Holzhausen; pre-orders began in 2017. The car was expected to begin production in late 2021 after production of the Model S Plaid commences, but has since seen further delays with an unclear production start date. The Roadster in this form would never see production as the Roadster was significantly redesigned, with an updated version unveiled in October 2026. The casting was originally intended to be a design for the Hot Wheels id line, but was moved to the Premium line in advance. This casting features a slanted front bumper and rear diffuser to allow it to negotiate loops on Hot Wheels tracks. This casting borrows a window piece from the Matchbox Tesla Roadster.

Subaru Legacy GT (BP).descripcion: The Subaru Legacy is a mid-sized car manufactured by Subaru from 1989 to 2025. The fourth generation Legacy, produced from 2003 to 2009 and codenamed BL and BP, was designed by Tōru Ōzeki, Hiroyuki Kobayashi and Tetsuya Jirōbō; it featured a complete redesign from the previous generation and was launched on 23 May 2003 in Japan. The Legacy GT was a more performance-oriented version of the Legacy, featuring all-wheel drive and either a 5-speed automatic or 6-speed manual. This casting is based on a 2005 Subaru Legacy GT owned by Hot Wheels Development Program Management Associate Antonio Gaido. In the trunk is a remote-controlled Subaru Impreza 22B STi, referencing a RC car owned by Gaido himself.

Toyota 4Runner TRD Pro.descripcion: The Toyota 4Runner (read: "forerunner") is a mid-sized sport utility vehicle (originally compact) sold around the world since 1984, replacing in North America the older Toyota Trekker, which was essentially a Toyota Hilux converted into an SUV by Winnebago. The sixth generation 4Runner, styled by Adam Rabinowitz and Kevin Hunter and introduced in 2024 for the 2025 model year, is built on the same platform as the Tacoma and shares many mechanical components with it; the 4Runner TRD Pro is a high-performance off-road trim, being powered by a 2.4L T24A-FTS turbocharged inline-4 with an iForce MAX hybrid system. Despite only being available in left-hand drive form the 4Runner is still built at Toyota's Tahara Plant in Aichi.

The AE86 has gained significant popularity as the titular car featured in the anime and manga series Initial D, as well as in the drifting and motorsport circuit. Shoe Box.descripcion: The Shoe Box is based on the 1949 Ford Custom Club Coupe. The 1949 Ford was an American automobile produced by Ford since 1948. It was the first all-new automobile design introduced by the Big Three after World War II, civilian production having been suspended during the war, and the 1946-1948 models from Ford, GM, and Chrysler being updates of their pre-war models. Popularly called the "Shoebox Ford" for its slab-sided, "ponton" design, the 1949 Ford is credited both with saving Ford and ushering in modern streamlined car design with changes such as integrated fenders and more. This design would continue through the 1951 model year, with an updated design offered in 1952.

'51 Le Sabre Concept.descripcion: The 51 Le Sabre Concept is based upon the real Le Sabre concept car, designed by Harley J. Earl and built by GM in 1951. It was featured in car shows around the world and sports the "jet airplane" look that was so prevalent in the 1950's. The car was powered by a 215 c.i. V-8 engine (≈ 3.5 L) with a Buick Dynaflow automatic transmission. The original car employed two carburetors - one which ran on premium gasoline when driving normally and another which used methanol when the accelerator pedal was stomped. This Hot Wheels faithfully recreates the silvery finish of the original, which the designer himself used as a daily driver. Still being shown in a General Motors museum, after 60 years, it still catches the eye.

'63 Studebaker Champ.descripcion: The '63 Studebaker Champ is a casting replicating a racing version of the classic early '60s light truck manufactured by Studebaker for the North American market. The Hot Wheels casting takes the basic truck and has it lowered and fitted with a tonneau cover. This tonneau cover is made from the same material as the interior piece and on versions with a plastic interior, a person can use their fingernail to lift it and reveal that this piece has the brackets molded to hold the rear wheels in place. The base of the casting reads '63 Studebaker. The casting was retooled in 2022; the wing is no longer part of the tonneau cover, instead being part of the body. There is a protrusion from the wing which acts as one of the rivet posts.

The first generation Bronco, styled by Donald Frey, Paul Axlerad and McKinley Thompson Jr., was introduced in August 1965 and intended to be a competitor to the Jeep CJ-5, International Scout and Toyota Land Cruiser. It was built upon a new chassis shared with no other Ford vehicles, used box section body-on-frame construction and was initially sold with a 170 ci (2.8L) Straight-6 derived from that of the Falcon. Although the car initially sold well following the introduction of new cars such as the Chevrolet Blazer, Jeep Cherokee and International Scout II demand declined, with the Bronco being discontinued in 1977 and the model redesigned to better compete with the shifting market segments. 13,125 were produced for 1

'78 Ford Mustang II.descripcion: This casting was based on (and inspired by) the Monroe Handler Mustang II of 1977. Built by Monroe Shocks and Hot Rod magazine, the original Monroe Handler was built to showcase Monroe’s new Handler line of shocks. The building of the Monroe Handler was chronicled in Hot Rod Magazine June, July and August issues. A one-off production based on the Mustang II, the Monroe Handler had a number of significant improvements, including a Roush-tuned 363ci engine producing 400 horses and a modified suspension. The car also featured an upgraded exterior with steel IMSA-style fenders and other enhancements by Creative Car Craft.

'80 Mercedes-Benz 500 SLC Rallye.descripcion: The Mercedes-Benz R107 and C107 were a series of sports cars produced by Mercedes-Benz from 1971 to 1989. Designed by Joseph Gallitzendörfer and Friedrich Geiger, the R107 and C107 acted as the successor to the W113 and were sold under the SL and SLC names. The 500 SLC was produced from 1980 to 1981 and was powered by a 5.0L M117 V8. A number of C107s were also taken racing, most notably in rally where they saw modest success. 300,175 R107 and C107s were produced; this was the second longest running series produced by Mercedes-Benz behind the G-Class. The base of the casting reads 1980 Mercedes-Benz 500 SLC Rallye.

'71 Mustang Mach 1.descripcion: The Ford Mustang Mach 1 is a performance-oriented package for the Ford Mustang produced from 1968 to 1978 and produced intermittently from 2003 to 2023. The Mustang Mach 1 was fitted with various performance and visual enhancements, and was only available on the SportsRoof (fastback) body style; standard equipment was a 351 ci (5.8L) Windsor V8 mated to a 3-speed manual. The Mach 1's success led to the discontinuation of the Mustang GT trim in 1969. The 1971 through 1973 Mach 1s can be identified through their dual hood scoops. 36,499 were produced for 1971.

'95 Lamborghini Diablo SV.descripcion: The Lamborghini Diablo is a two-seat mid-engined high-performance sports car manufactured by Lamborghini from 1990 to 2001. Styled by Tom Gale, the Diablo acted as Lamborghini's flagship car and the replacement for the Countach; it is powered by a L522 5.7L V12 mated to a 5-speed manual. The name "Diablo" translates to "devil" in Spanish and like most Lamborghini cars is named for a fighting bull. The Diablo SV was the high-performance version of the Diablo, introduced at the 1995 Geneva Motor Show; it revived the "SV" title last used on the Miura and featured an uprated engine producing 517 horsepower and some exterior changes. 346 Diablo SVs were produced. 1974 Chevy C10.descripcion: The Chevrolet C/K is a series of trucks manufactured by the Chevrolet division of General Motors. The third generation of the C/K, styled by Bill Mitchell, was introduced in 1973 and was known as the Rounded Line series. This generation of C/K introduced a four door cab configuration as well as trim levels, including the Cheyenne, Scottsdale and Silverado trims. The vehicle's styling included a recessed front grille with orange turn signals; 1974 added an option for door-mounted drip moldings, with those becoming standard in 1975. The third generation C/K was discontinued in 1991, although it was superseded midway through 1988 with a new generation of C/K truck.

1967 Volkswagen Samba Bus.descripcion: The Volkswagen Type 2 is a series of commercial vehicles manufactured by Volkswagen; the first generation, designated the T1 and designed by Ben Pon, was introduced in 1949 and featured a split-screen front windshield. The Samba Bus, officially the Kleinbus Sonderausführung (lit. "small bus special version"), was a version of the T1 with twenty-one or twenty-three windows and a skylight roof. The origin of the Samba name is unclear although it first appeared in Dutch literature. T1 production ended in 1967. This casting depicts a 1967 Volkswagen Bus owned by American comedian Gabriel Iglesias, named "Iron Man"; Iglesias is notable for owning numerous Volkswagen buses.

2003 Ford Focus RS.descripcion: The Ford Focus is a compact car manufactured by Ford from 1998 to 2005. It debuted a new design language, named New Edge, which was deemed as polarizing. The Focus RS was a high-performance version of the Focus, being introduced in 2002 and produced until 2003. It was powered by a 2.0L Duratec-RS turbocharged inline-4 mated to a 5-speed Ford MTX-75 manual and was built at Ford's Saarlouis Plant. 4,501 were produced.

Amphicar.descripcion: The Amphicar Model 770 was a German amphibious two-seat automobile manufactured by the Quandt Group from 1960 to 1965 and marketed until 1968. Designed by Hans Trippel, the Amphicar was a spiritual successor to the Volkswagen Type 128 and 166 and the Trippel SG6 schwimmwagens. The car was powered by a 1.1L Triumph inline-4 and could drive on both land and water, offering modest performance in both aspects. 3,878 were produced. This casting depicts an Amphicar with a blown engine.

Aston Martin DBS.descripcion: The Aston Martin DBS V12, officially known as the DBS, is a high-performance two-seat grand touring sports car manufactured by Aston Martin from 2007 to 2010, acting as the flagship vehicle of the marque, replacing the previous generation Vanquish. Styled by Marek Reichman, the DBS V12 is powered by a 5.9L AM08 V12 mated to a 6-speed automatic or manual, producing 510 horsepower. The car was most notable for appearing in the James Bond films Casino Royale and Quantum of Solace; the vehicles used in the former film are DBS test mules based on DB9s. Production ended in 2012 with the reintroduction of the Vanquish name to the Aston Martin lineup. 3,381 were produced.

Powered by a 4.0L P65 V8 making 485 horsepower, the car was mainly intended for competition in the American Le Mans Series. M3 GT2s also competed in the 24 Hours of Le Mans in 2010 and 2011, run by BMW Motorsport; their first attempt ended without much fanfare but their second attempt ended with a third place in class. Bone Shaker.descripcion: Bone Shaker is a rat rod created by Larry Wood. This casting has undergone several retoolings beginning in 2011 where it was given a police light bar and push bar, then again in 2015 where the casting lost its roll cage, the lightbar was also altered along with the spoiler which was integrated into the metal body. Ford Mustang GT Concept.descripcion: The Mustang GT Concept is a Hot Wheels casting based on concept car displayed at the 2003 North American International Auto Show, debuting in the 2004 First Editions. This concept served as a preview for the 2005 Ford Mustang. In 2009, this casting was tooled to have a light bar on top so it could be used as a police vehicle. The casting was retooled in 2021; it now features a push bar and a somewhat more realistic depiction of the sirens in that they now poke out of a cavity as opposed to being cast with the roof.

Ferrari F40 (1989).descripcion: The Ferrari F40 is a two-door high-performance sports car produced by Ferrari from 1987 to 1992. Designed by Pietro Camardella under Aldo Brovarone, the F40 was intended as the successor to the 288 GTO and was named as such to celebrate Ferrari's 40th anniversary. At the time of its introduction, the F40 was Ferrari's fastest, most powerful and most expensive car for sale; with an initial planned production total of 400 units. Golden Submarine.descripcion: The Golden Submarine was an early race car designed and built by Fred Offenhauser and Harry Miller for Barney Oldfield in 1917. It was designed to be fast and durable as well as being able to protect its driver in the event of an accident. Costing $15,000 to build, the Golden Submarine was powered by a 289 ci (4.7L) inline-4 producing 136 horsepower built by Miller. It was known to have competed in 54 races, winning 20 of them. The Golden Submarine was last owned by J. Allen Sloan of Illinois, where it is said to have been destroyed at an indeterminate time after being stored in one of Sloan's barns which caught fire. Many replicas are known to have been built.

Hot Tub.descripcion: Hot Tub is a hot rodded hot tub/spa, with the driver being immersed in water due to the seat being directly inside the tub. Due to its full-metal construction Hot Tub is often seen as a prime choice for downhill racing. The name is a double entendre, the actual name of the tub and "Hot", as in Hot Wheels. The casting was retooled in 2021, losing the metal base and gaining a new plastic base; this plastic base has all the originally hollow parts of the base filled in. The casting also gained a plastic spoiler which is part of the pool insert. The engine was cast into the body. The seat and steering wheel are also now part of the tub and the wing, seat & steering was also moved outwards against the tub walls.

The Packin' Pacer was re-tooled for the 2011 Hot Ones Series and has seen several versions since.

Paddy Wagon.descripcion: The Paddy Wagon is a Hot Wheels casting which debuted in 1970. It is based on the Monogram Model Kit which was originally designed by Tom Daniel. After a 1994 release in the FAO Schwarz Gold Series Collection, it wasn't seen until 2009 where it was re-released again as part of the Classics Series and renamed the Copper Stopper. The 1970 Redline Model Car came packaged with either a metal or plastic 'Collector's Button'.

Pontiac Fiero 2M4.descripcion: The Pontiac Fiero is a rear mid-engined light sports car manufactured by the Pontiac division of General Motors; its name translates to a number of words in Spanish and Italian to indicate intensity. Designed by Hulki Aldikacti and George Milidrag, the Fiero was intended as a small and affordable sports car with modest performance. Two variants were produced, the 2M4 and 2M6, indicating the car's layout and use of engine; the 2M4 used a 2.5L Iron Duke LR8 inline-4 mated to a number of transmissions. The engine choices were to allow the car to meet California's emissions standards with its chassis and low selling price contributing to the car's unique selling proposition. Production began in 1984 and ended in 1988 due to annual falling sales. 370,168 were produced.

Rigor Motor.descripcion: Rigor Motor is a hot rod shaped like a coffin or casket; its name is a play on "rigor mortis" (the stiffening of a dead body) and "motor". The shape of Rigor Motor's bubble canopy resembles the cockpit of the similarly coffin-based "DRAG-U-LA" show car, designed by Tom Daniel for the sitcom The Munsters. In 2014, changes to the casting were apparently made, but there are no noticeable differences. In 2017, a major change to the casting was made, with the front bird ornament cast into the body, the skull ornaments removed, the canopy and engine made smaller and the base made plastic; these were ostensibly made for cost-cutting.

Toyota GR Yaris.descripcion: The Toyota GR Yaris is a sport compact car manufactured by Toyota since 2020. Designed by Shōta Itō, Takeo Okuno and Byung-kang Cho, the GR Yaris was designed essentially as a homologation special for World Rally Championship rules. The car itself is powered by a 1.6L G16E-GTS turbocharged inline-3 mated to a 6-speed Toyota EA67F manual (although an 8-speed GR-DAT automatic has been made available since 2024); the car produces up to 300 horsepower. The car itself is all-wheel drive and is only available for sale in markets where the standard Yaris is sold; it is built on a dedicated production line at Toyota's Motomachi Plant. Markets which did not receive the GR Yaris would receive the GR Corolla instead.

Toyota Land Cruiser FJ43.descripcion: The Toyota Land Cruiser is a series of four-wheel drive vehicles produced by Toyota since 1950; originally intended for off-roading, the line has since morphed into a luxury SUV. The third generation of the Land Cruiser, internally designated the J40, was introduced in 1960 and produced until 1984; it was available in a number of different configurations, such as pickup and SUV. The FJ43 was a medium-wheelbase version of the FJ40, available in either soft- or hardtop; it is stated to be "extremely rare". Much of the design of this model is derived from the Toyota Land Cruiser introduced in 2021.

Triumph TR6.descripcion: The Triumph TR6 was a British 2-seat convertible sports car manufactured by the Triumph Motor Company from 1968 to 1976. Styled by Wilhelm Karmann GmbH of Germany, the TR6 was one of the first UK cars of the British Leyland era, a time marked by strikes, shoddy workmanship and highly unreliable cars. It was powered by a 2.5L inline-6 mated to a 4-speed manual. 91,850 were produced from 1968 to 1976, with the vast majority of TR6s being exported to the United States. It would be replaced with the TR7, noted for its wedged shape as styled by Harris Mann. This casting depicts a heavily modified TR6 converted to an open-top track car without the windscreen, giving it a roll cage, single racing bucket seat and a cab-mounted fuel tank. This casting is right-hand drive.

The Demon.descripcion: The Demon was a car in the 1970 Hot Wheels series, based on the Dave Stuckey customized '32 Ford Lil' Coffin show car of the '50s-60s. Generally found with black interior, it can be found with white interior. Magenta is found with white interior only and is considered rare. The model was packaged with a metal or plastic Collector's Button. The Demon was renamed Prowler (variously named in sources as either Prowler or The Prowler) in 1973 due to apparent complains from religious parents. It was released in various assorted enamel colors as all 1973 Hot Wheels were. Straight axles were used as opposed to bent axles to cut further costs. The casting got a new tool & die to be released as The Demon in 1993 for the 25th Anniversary Series and current reissues. Since 2007 the casting was renamed

Tucker Torpedo.descripcion: Preston Tucker was a maverick. Immediately following WWII he published the preliminary design for his "car of the Future". By 1947 the Tucker 48 (initally called the Torpedo) was in production, boasting many innovative safety features including seat belts, plus a hugely powerful rear-mounted flat-6 water-cooled engine, a slippery aerodynamic body, rubber suspension and a "Cyclops' Eye" third headlight coupled to the steering linkage. So why were only 51 examples produced before the company folded? Conspiracy theories abound, but you can judge for yourself by watching the 1988 movie "Tucker - The Man and His Dream".

Vector W8 Twinturbo.descripcion: The Vector W8 is a high-performance American sports car designed by Jerry Wiegert and David Kostka. The car was built using the latest aerospace materials, with Wiegert referring to the manufacture of the car as "aeromotive engineering"; the car was powered by a 6.0L Rodeck racing V8 with variable boost twin turbochargers. In essence, the W8 was a highly refined version of the W2 prototype, featuring a very similar appearance. Production was forced to halt when Vector was forcefully taken over by MegaTech, an Indonesian company with Bermudan ties; 22 were produced. According to designer Manson Cheung, there are no current plans to re-release this casting or other Vectors into the mainline or Premium lines due to licensing issues.

Vairy 8.descripcion: The Vairy 8 is based on a racing version of the Chevrolet Corvair. The Corvair was labeled as the "the leading candidate for the un-safest car" by Ralph Nadar, a consumer protection activist, in his book titled, 'Unsafe at Any Speed'. As a nod to this, the First Edition of the car was decorated with 'Ralph's Ride' tampos. Its name is a play on words with "Variate", "Corvair" and "V-8" because the Hot Wheels version is modified for racing and has 8 cylinders while the real-life version had a Flat-6.

VW Bug.descripcion: The VW Bug & Volkswagen (later UK only card name) is a Hot Wheels casting based on a 1953 - 1957 VW Bug and was created by Hot Wheels designer Larry Wood. It was released into the line-up in 1989. This is not the first Bug to be in the Hot Wheels line-up; the Original Bugs or Beetles were released as part of the 1968 "Sweet Sixteen". Although the Custom Volkswagen was issued in two different countries back then and were very different from each other, this resembles the Hong Kong casting. There was it’s other famous striped cousin the Volkswagen (1974) which more resembles the US version of the Custom Volkswagen. In 2007, the VW Bug was renamed to the Volkswagen Beetle. The casting features the same toy number, 7671, as the Chevy Monza 2+2.

Volkswagen Käfer Racer.descripcion: The Volkswagen Käfer Racer is a silhouette race car based on a Volkswagen Beetle. Designed by Mark Jones, his objective was "to find the ultimate, crazy racing VW", but one that Volkswagen would agree to because of licensing. Jones took a Custom Beetle and added some parts to the underside and the back. The Käfer Racer appears to have taken inspiration from a VW Beetle Super Saloon and VWs racing in the Fun Cup. The first release was inspired by the Momo-sponsored Porsche 935/78-81 'Moby Dick' raced by Gianpiero Moretti in the IMSA GT series in the early 1980s. The car has downforce tunnels on the underside of the Beetle, a V8 engine with two exhaust pipes sticking out, and an air scoop on the roof.

Twin Mill.descripcion: Twin Mill is an aerodynamic twin-engined concept car originally designed by Ira Gilford for the 1969 Hot Wheels lineup. It is recognized as Hot Wheels's first original design, done from the ground up at Mattel with no external input. It features a doorless canopy design, with entry and egress done through an opening canopy up top, as well as two large big block engines. Today, Twin Mill is a highly popular model and is often considered the most iconic Hot Wheels model, alongside other models like the Bone Shaker, Deora II, Rodger Dodger, and the '67 Camaro. Twin Mill's first release was painted in several Spectraflame colors and came with Redline wheels. It was manufactured in the USA and could be found with either a white or dark brown interior. It was based in part on Volkswagen's Beetle Type I, and was a continuation and improvement over the Kübelwagen, which had been used by the German military during World War II. '09 Custom Ford Transit Connect.descripcion: The Ford Transit Connect is a compact panel van developed by Ford Europe and produced since 2002. The current generation, in production since 2012, was designed by Paul Wraith and features a number of new design changes such as the MyKey personalized key system and an optional rear liftgate in conjunction with the double rear doors. This casting depicts a heavily modified 2009 Ford Transit Connect with a widebody kit, mid-engine layout, a new hood with NACA ducts, rear ducktail-style wing, lowered ride height and dual exhausts poking out the tailgate. The interior can be seen by flipping a tab on the base to release the body from the base. The supercharged V8 engine is all-metal and the vehicle is right-hand-drive.

Volkswagen Drag Bus.descripcion: This casting depicts a T1-generation Volkswagen Type 2 panel van heavily modified for drag racing, with conversion to a silhouette body and mid-engine layout and a large "stinger" exhaust. The Volkswagen Drag Bus was designed by Phil Riehlman and has his initials, PR, cast into the bottom of the rear differential. This casting, when released, was the heaviest casting Mattel made, and the most popular. The base of the casting reads VW Bus.

Whatta Drag.descripcion: Whatta Drag is a Hot Wheels casting that debuted in the 1998 Hot Wheels line. Designed by Phil Riehlman, Whatta Drag heavily modified the BMW Isetta 3-wheel bubble-car and turned it into a V8-powered dragster. In 2005, Bruce Weiner of the [http://microcarmuseum.com/tour/whattadrag.html%7CBruce Weiner Microcar Museum] commissioned John Eversley of Evermoor Engineering LTD in Winder, GA to build a working, life-size version of this car, using a 1959 Isetta, a supercharged Chevy Big Block V8 and a massive single rear wheel; conceived by Bruce and a Hot Wheels model as the blueprint.

'52 Chevy Truck.descripcion: The Chevrolet Advance Design is a series of trucks manufactured by Chevrolet from 1947 to 1955. It was their first major redesign of truck after World War II with a sleeker design compared to the previous AK series of trucks. It was available in a number of different formats, such as pickup truck, cab over engine, station wagon and even SUV in the form of the Chevrolet Suburban. A highly successful design, Chevrolet trucks were the best selling trucks in the United States in all the years it was sold. The Advance Design line was replaced with the Task Force line in 1956. This casting has no interior piece.
